title: Court's Turbulence
next_chapter_hook: At the instant Ling Yuan was suppressed, a pitch-black fissure tore open above the Imperial Capital. Dimension invaders from beyond the Three Realms revealed their despair-inducing outlines for the first time.

text.content: Above the Imperial Capital, a vast ethereal shadow hung in the ninth heaven like the brush of fate. The lingering echoes of the fate-scribe from ten thousand years ago had not yet dissipated, and the entire imperial city was already shrouded in a murderous oppressive force. Within the Observer Tribunal's hall, twelve Heavenly Principle Pillars radiated ghostly blue light, enveloping the entire judgment platform. Su Qingyao stood on the high platform in black judge's robes, her dignified bearing no longer comparable to that of a former Inner Disciple Senior Fellow—this was the true strongman's aura that had been tempered through life and death.

Chen Ji stood in the shadows of the observer's gallery, his Servant Disciple gray robe making him utterly unremarkable. He gazed down at the faintly visible Tianji Record pattern in his palm, a faint smile curling his lips—Ling Yuan had indeed come. He had deduced this today's situation three days prior; otherwise, that 'Heavenly Secret Shield Talisman' obtained from the Holy Sect's secret vault would not have been activated last night. On fate's chessboard, every move was a piece he had placed himself.

dialogue.content: Observer Tribunal, first session in session. Presiding over the case of remnants of the old faction colluding with foreign enemies, intending to subvert the new order. This seat Su Qingyao, authorized by the Observers to serve as Chief Adjudicator, effective today.

text.content: Her voice echoed through the tribunal dome, each word carrying the resonance of Heavenly Principle Laws. In the observer's gallery, over a thousand dignitaries from the three major Sects and various families had gathered, yet none dared make a single sound. Master Mo's remnant soul had told her—the Observer Tribunal represented the cornerstone of the new order across the Three Realms. Anyone who challenged its authority would suffer backlash from the Heavenly Principle Laws.

dialogue.content: Reporting to the Chief Adjudicator, Ye Qing, Saintess of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, brings ironclad evidence of the old Sect's collusion with foreign enemies, requesting to present evidence to the court!

text.content: Ye Qing entered from the side door, holding a storage ring that radiated ghostly light. Her expression was unprecedentedly grave, utterly different from her usual enchanting demeanor. Communication jade slips from over a hundred old Sect elders, thirty-seven secret agreements, three maps marking defensive weaknesses of the Three Realms—once these evidences were made public, they would be enough to shake the entire cultivation world. With every step she took, she seemed to tread upon countless departed souls.

When Ye Qing placed that storage ring on the evidence platform at the center of the judgment seat, the information that surged out from the ring struck like a flood into the spiritual senses of everyone present—the complete evidence chain of the old Sect's collusion with extra-dimensional forces over three years. Within the Xuanwu Sect, Qingyun Gate, even inside the Tianqing Sect, shadows were plotting in secret. Uproar erupted in the observer's gallery; some faces turned ashen white, others were enraged beyond measure.

dialogue.content: Order! The evidence is conclusive and足以定罪 sufficient for conviction. This seat pronounces the verdict—

text.content: An aged yet vigorous voice rang out from the tribunal's main entrance. Ling Yuan, draped in dark cyan Taoist robes with a sword on his back, stepped into the hall through the blue light of the Heavenly Principle Pillars. His pace was unhurried, each step seemingly treading upon the heartbeats of all living beings. That was the bearing of one who truly stood at the pinnacle of the cultivation world—several thousand years of accumulated pressure like a mountain collapsing, leaving most present nearly unable to breathe.

dialogue.content: This old man is Ling Yuan, current盟主 Leader of the Heavenly Principle Guardian Alliance, and humbly serves as former Patriarch of the Tianqing Sect. I dare ask Chief Adjudicator Su—in what authority does this Observer Tribunal possess the right to judge all under heaven?

text.content: The moment these words fell, the atmosphere within the tribunal plummeted to freezing point. Behind Ling Yuan, over a dozen elders with profound auras filed in one after another—those were the core elders of the Heavenly Principle Guardian Alliance, any single one of whom could intimidate an entire region. His question was not about the tribunal's jurisdiction, but a challenge to the legitimacy of the entire Observer new order. In the observer's gallery, people began whispering, some faces showing anticipation—the old faction's counterattack had officially begun.

dialogue.content: The Observer Tribunal is recognized by Heavenly Principle Laws and exercises judgment on Heaven's behalf. If Alliance Leader Ling has objections, by all means—

text.content: Ling Yuan interrupted her, a sneer forming on his aged face. He waved his hand, and a sword intent sufficient to tear apart the heavens surged directly toward the Heavenly Principle Pillar—that was provocation, a declaration of war, a blatant trampling upon Observer authority. In his view, the so-called Observers were merely a group of thieves who had stolen Heavenly Secrets; he had waited for this day for three thousand years.

At the instant that sword intent was about to touch the Heavenly Principle Pillar, Chen Ji finally moved. He stepped out slowly from the shadows, his gray robe rustling loudly in everyone's gaze. His expression remained that habitual timid appearance, yet when he raised his head, what reflected in those eyes was the entire chessboard. Three thousand years of scheming, countless fates, were merely pieces to be slaughtered in his view.

Ling Yuan, this seat sentences you—of crimes against heaven.

Alliance Leader Ling, you seem to have forgotten too much about your own past?

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, yielding the stage to Ling Yuan.
Alliance Leader Ling is correct—this tribunal should indeed have a more fitting way, aligned with Heavenly Principles. Please, do as you wish.

Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply. He stared at Chen Ji's utterly ordinary face, as if seeing this Servant Disciple's full picture for the first time. Memories from three thousand years ago surged like a tide—the youth chosen by the Tianji Record, the castaway chosen by fate, the piece that should have died long ago. How was he still alive? How dare he appear here?

Chen Ji did not answer Ling Yuan's questioning. He slowly raised his right hand, a mark flowing with the power of fate appearing in his palm. That mark resonated with the vast ethereal shadow in the sky, and everyone present felt a pressure from the very source of Heavenly Principles—that was Observer authority, the highest authority surpassing all Sect doctrines.

dialogue.content: Elder Ling Yuan, you just asked me what right the Observer Tribunal has to judge all under heaven—now, do you know the answer?

text.content: His tone was casual, as if merely asking about today's weather. Yet this light remark exploded like thunder in everyone's ears—this Servant Disciple deemed as worthless was actually the legitimate heir of the legendary Observer? Ling Yuan's expression finally changed; it was a transformation unlike any before.
Impossible! The inheritance of the Tianji Record was long severed! You are bluffing!

Chen Ji laughed lightly, his fingers tracing a trajectory through the air. In an instant, scenes appeared above the tribunal—an image from three thousand two hundred years ago, a young man kneeling before a dying elder, accepting a blood-stained fragment.

Everyone, please observe—this is the original contract from when the Heavenly Principle Guardian Alliance was established. Elder Ling Yuan, your own handwritten signature agreed to place the Alliance under the jurisdiction of the Tianji Record inheritor, with violators suffering Heavenly Principle backlash. Just now, when you attacked the Heavenly Principle Pillar, according to the agreement, you should be executed.

The images in the light projection caused an uproar throughout the hall. That was indeed Ling Yuan's handwritten signature, the brushwork, the aura, all matching perfectly. Ling Yuan's chest heaved violently; he never imagined that the soul contract he had signed three thousand years ago to seize control of the Alliance would become a blade piercing his own heart. He wanted to deny it, but every word he had spoken at that time was clearly audible in the images.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! You are merely a孽种 cursed spawn who窃取天机 stole Heavenly Secrets! The Tianji Record should belong to the Heavenly Principle Guardian Alliance! Should belong to—

text.content: Chen Ji interrupted his words, his voice still flat, yet the blade-edge within it sent chills down spines. He raised his hand again, dozens of light screens blooming simultaneously above the tribunal—all of Ling Yuan's unspeakable transactions over three thousand years: secret collaborations with the Demonic Path Holy Sect, rosters of Tianqing Sect disciples sold out, evidence of secretly supporting foreign enemies. Each piece was enough to condemn Ling Yuan to endless doom.

Ling Yuan's face was completely contorted. The reputation he had cultivated for three thousand years, the schemes he had plotted for three thousand years, all turned to ashes in this moment. He wanted to act, but the Observer authority's suppression prevented even his spiritual energy from circulating. He wanted to defend himself, but the ironclad evidence left him speechless. The堂堂 dignified former Patriarch of the Tianqing Sect was now as狼狈 miserable as a丧家之犬 stray dog.

Chen Ji walked slowly toward Ling Yuan, each step seemingly crushing down on the other's heart. He looked down at this once-untouchable old enemy, his eyes containing no anger, no satisfaction—only an abyss of cold indifference. He bore grudges and never acted rashly—the account of three thousand years, he would settle today, item by item.

Ling Yuan, where is that arrogance you displayed just now? Where is the resentment you harbored when abandoned by the Tianji Record three thousand years ago? What did you think the Heavenly Principle Guardian Alliance was—a tool for your revenge? Unfortunately, fate already wrote the script; from the very start, you were merely a discarded piece on the chessboard.

Ling Yuan's eye sockets nearly split open; he opened his mouth, but only emitted a hoarse gasp of air. Chen Ji's words were like dull blades, stripping away his three-thousand-year pride piece by piece. He finally realized that this seemingly worthless Servant Disciple had been playing a game he could never comprehend from start to finish. And he, was merely dust ground beneath fate's wheels.

At this moment, a pitch-black fissure tore open above the Imperial Capital. The aura emanating from that rift was entirely different from the Three Realms—that was the chill of the Chaos Void, the first time dimension以外的入侵者 outside invaders revealed their outlines. The Heavenly Principle Pillars' light swayed violently, the temperature within the tribunal dropping dozens of degrees. In the instant Ling Yuan was suppressed, the terrifying existence beyond the Three Realms finally could no longer restrain itself, beginning to knock on the world's door.
